m.d: If you ejaculate, you eject semen from your penis.
Of a human being or other mammal: to forcibly eject from the urethra in response to sexual stimulation, in a male, semen.
Fluid or some other substance ejected or suddenly thrown from a duct or other body structure.
Ejaculation is the action of ejecting semen from the body.
The act of ejecting or suddenly throwing fluid or some other substance from a duct or other body structure.
A person or thing that ejaculates.
A device that stimulates the sex organs of a male animal with electric impulses in order to extract semen from an animal.
To eject can mean to force (a person or people) to leave.
To be ejected can also mean to be thrown out of something quickly.
A button on a machine that ejects something from the machine.
An inferred object of someone else's consciousness
Material which has been ejected, especially from a volcano or an impact crater.
Ejection is the act of ejecting.
One who, or that which, ejects or dispossesses.
Ejector seat: a pilot's seat in an airplane that can be forcibly ejected in the case of an emergency; then the pilot descends by parachute.
